description: Conversation-driven motion & interactivity for the TWO conversational demos (Chef + Coach). Surface an ADDITIVE reply classification from the existing engines (no parallel state machine, no reply-text change, no input-parsing change), make the scenes reframe the camera in RESPONSE to that engine output, add ONE clickable 3D prop per scene that dispatches a REAL query through the SAME send() input path the chat box uses, and add small ambient life gated so heavier motion is High-only. This is the core 'interactions route through the existing brain' feature, mirroring tireshop's reply.intent + useConversation.send().
steps: ENGINE METADATA (additive only). In lib/chef/chefEngine.ts, extend the ChefResponse interface with an OPTIONAL field, e.g. `focus?: 'recipe' | 'ingredients' | 'suggest' | 'greeting' | 'chat'` (name it clearly, document it). Populate it at EACH existing return branch of respondToMessage from the branch the engine ALREADY chose (steps/ingredients/describe/suggest/greeting/fallback) — do NOT add new parsing, do NOT change the reply text or suggestions. This mirrors tireshop's reply.intent: the classification is a read-out of the decision the engine already made.

Do the same additively in lib/coach/coachEngine.ts (CoachResponse at ~line 33): add an OPTIONAL focus field (e.g. 'workout' | 'exercises' | 'walkthrough' | 'suggest' | 'greeting' | 'chat') set from the branch already taken. No reply/parsing changes.

CHEF: in components/chef/ChefChatbot.tsx, capture response.focus alongside reply in send() (it is already computed once per send) and pass it into ChefScene as a prop (plus a monotonic nonce so the SAME focus re-triggers a camera move), exactly how VirtualPet passes action+actionNonce. Do NOT compute focus in the component — read it from the engine response.

CHEF camera-in-response: in components/chef/ChefScene.tsx add an engine-driven camera nudge that is LAYERED on top of the pinned framing. Do NOT change AIM_HEIGHT (1.3), CAMERA_DISTANCE (2.2), fov, AIM_MODEL_FRACTION, MODEL_SCALE or the lookAt target constants. Implement by animating a small additive offset to the camera position / a small target offset in a useFrame easing toward a per-focus pose (e.g. a subtle push-in + slight downward tilt when focus==='ingredients'/'recipe' to 'look at what the chef is presenting', ease back to rest otherwise), then ease back to the rest framing. Keep the move small (a few cm of distance, a few degrees) so it reads as a nudge, never a re-frame that fights the locked shot. Prefer drei easing helpers (damp/damp3) over hand-rolled lerps; if a new drei import is needed it is already an installed dep (OK).

CHEF clickable prop: add ONE clickable object in the chef scene (e.g. the toque/hat area or a small clickable 'sample dish' plate placed within frame using a procedural mesh — no new asset; if any texture/asset is truly needed, STOP and flag it). On pointer down it must call a callback passed from ChefChatbot that invokes the SAME send() with a real user-style query string (e.g. send('Suggest a recipe')), so the engine produces the answer and the transcript + voice + focus all flow exactly as if the user typed it. The scene MUST NOT contain any recipe text or answer. Use drei useCursor for hover affordance (installed). Give the mesh an accessible pointer affordance only; keep the WS4 a11y scope out.

COACH: mirror the chef wiring in components/coach/CoachChatbot.tsx + components/coach/CoachScene.tsx — pass focus+nonce to the scene, add the layered engine-driven camera nudge (respect AIM_HEIGHT 1.3, CAMERA_DISTANCE 2.4, do not touch the group motion constants), and add ONE clickable prop (e.g. a clickable dumbbell/kettlebell primitive within frame) whose handler calls the SAME send() with a real query (e.g. send('Suggest a workout')). No workout text in the scene.

AMBIENT LIFE (both scenes): add subtle, cheap ambient motion that is not tied to speaking (so the scene isn't dead when idle) — e.g. a gentle idle breathing already exists for coach; add a light, cheap ambient element (a slow drifting particle/steam wisp for the chef kitchen, a subtle floor-dust or light shimmer for the gym) using cheap procedural meshes/points. GATE any heavier ambient motion to High (quality==='high') so the WS2 Fast path frame time does not regress; on Fast keep only what already ran. Do not add external assets.

Confirm the engines' existing behavior is unchanged: the reply strings and suggestions for representative inputs must be identical to before (the focus field is additive). Add a short note in each engine file's header comment describing the additive focus field and that it is a read-out of the existing branch decision.
Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build`; fix any type errors from the new optional field / props. Keep everything behind the ssr:false dynamic wrappers (unchanged).
acceptance_criteria: ChefResponse and CoachResponse each expose a new OPTIONAL focus field, populated at every existing return branch WITHOUT changing reply text, suggestions, or input parsing (verify by diffing reply outputs for a few sample inputs before/after — identical).

In both chef and coach scenes the camera performs a small, eased, engine-driven move keyed to the engine's focus (not hard-coded per keyword in the view; the view only reacts to the focus value the engine returned) and eases back to the pinned rest framing; AIM_HEIGHT / CAMERA_DISTANCE / fov / MODEL_SCALE / AIM_MODEL_FRACTION constants are unchanged.

Each scene has exactly ONE clickable 3D object whose click handler calls the component's existing send() with a real query string, so the answer is produced by respondToMessage (engine), appears in the transcript, and drives the same speaking/focus path. No recipe/workout answer text exists in any scene component.

Ambient life is visible when idle; any heavier ambient motion is gated to quality==='high'. No new external asset added (or, if one was genuinely required, the coder STOPPED and flagged the exact package/asset).
`npm run lint` clean (font warning aside) and `npm run build` static export succeeds with all routes prerendering.
verification: npm run lint && npm run build both pass (font warning aside).

Cite the code path in findings for each new interaction: click handler -> ChefChatbot/CoachChatbot send(query) -> respondToMessage(history, query) in the engine -> reply/focus -> transcript+scene. Confirm no answer text is constructed in the scene component.
Grep the scene components to confirm they import NO recipe/workout content and contain no answer strings; the only content flowing in is via props/callbacks from the chatbot.
Show a representative before/after of respondToMessage output for 3-4 inputs (chef and coach) proving reply+suggestions are byte-identical and only focus was added.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED on branch motion/interactivity (chef + coach only; pet/wardrobe untouched — those are FEAT-003).

ENGINE METADATA (additive, no behavior change):
- lib/chef/chefEngine.ts: added `export type ChefFocus = 'greeting'|'ingredients'|'recipe'|'suggest'|'chat'` and an OPTIONAL `focus?: ChefFocus` on ChefResponse. Populated focus at EVERY existing return branch of respondToMessage from the branch already chosen (empty/greeting/thanks/help -> 'greeting'; ingredients -> 'ingredients'; steps -> 'recipe'; describe/suggest/find/diet/llm-spread -> 'suggest'; fallback -> 'chat'). For the replyFromLlm() branches, focus is spread on top of the helper's ChefResponse (`{ ...replyFromLlm(...), focus: 'suggest' }`). No parsing, reply-text, or suggestions change. Added a header note describing the additive field.
- lib/coach/coachEngine.ts: added `export type CoachFocus = 'greeting'|'exercises'|'walkthrough'|'suggest'|'chat'` and OPTIONAL `focus?: CoachFocus` on CoachResponse. Populated at every branch (greeting/thanks/help -> 'greeting'; walkthrough -> 'walkthrough'; exercises -> 'exercises'; filter-list/describe/suggest-spread -> 'suggest'; fallback -> 'chat'). Added header note.

ENGINE OUTPUT PROVEN UNCHANGED: a throwaway harness (node --experimental-strip-types with a tiny resolver mapping @/ + extensionless TS + json import attrs; deleted afterward, not committed) ran respondToMessage([], input) for 6 chef + 6 coach representative inputs BEFORE (git-stashed engines) and AFTER, capturing ONLY {reply, suggestions}. Result: byte-identical (6639 bytes both runs, Buffer.equals === true). focus values verified populated: chef hi->greeting, 'Suggest a recipe'->suggest, 'How do I make lentil soup?'->recipe; coach hello->greeting, 'walk me through the core crusher'->walkthrough, 'Suggest a workout'->suggest.

ROUTING (interactions go through the EXISTING send() / respondToMessage brain; mirrors tireshop reply.intent + useConversation.send()):
- Chef click path: SampleDishProp.onPointerDown (ChefScene) -> onSampleDishClick prop -> ChefChatbot `() => send('Suggest a recipe')` -> existing send() -> respondToMessage(history,'Suggest a recipe') -> {reply,suggestions,focus} -> transcript + voice.speak + setFocus/setFocusNonce. Coach click path: KettlebellProp.onPointerDown (CoachScene) -> onKettlebellClick -> CoachChatbot `() => send('Suggest a workout')` -> existing send() -> respondToMessage -> transcript+voice+focus. The scenes construct NO answer text: grep for recipe/ingredient/servings in ChefScene.tsx and workout/exercise/reps/sets in CoachScene.tsx = 0 matches; each scene imports only `import type { ChefFocus }`/`{ CoachFocus }` (types, not content/engine fn).
- Chef/Coach send() capture focus: response.focus read straight off the engine result and pushed to state with a monotonic focusNonce (bumped every send) — NOT computed in the component — exactly like VirtualPet's action + actionNonce.

CAMERA (layered, engine-driven, pinned constants untouched):
- ChefScene/CoachScene each add a <CameraRig focus focusNonce/> that reacts ONLY to the engine's focus value (no keyword re-derivation). It eases a small ADDITIVE offset (a few cm push-in + a few degrees look-down for ingredients/recipe|exercises/walkthrough; a small settle-back for suggest) via drei's maath easing damp3/damp, composes camera.position = PINNED_CAM + offset and re-aims at PINNED_LOOK + lookOffset, and relaxes a per-nonce pulse to 0 over ~1.2s so it always eases back to the locked shot (and the SAME focus re-fires on a fresh nonce). AIM_HEIGHT (1.3), CAMERA_DISTANCE (chef 2.2 / coach 2.4), fov 34, AIM_MODEL_FRACTION 0.82, MODEL_SCALE 0.001, the lookAt target and the coach group bob/sway/lean constants are ALL unchanged. Tone mapping stays ACESFilmic on both.

CLICKABLE PROP (exactly ONE per scene, procedural, NO new asset): chef = SampleDishProp (procedural plate + hemispherical cloche + knob); coach = KettlebellProp (sphere body + half-torus handle). Both use drei useCursor for hover, an eased idle wobble/hover-lift, stopPropagation on pointer events, and route the click through send(). No textures/models added.

AMBIENT LIFE (cheap, always-on; heavier gated to High): chef = SteamWisps (rising/drifting soft points, 26 on High / 10 on Fast); coach = FloorShimmer (low drifting soft points, 22 on High / 8 on Fast). Both use an in-memory CanvasTexture sprite (no external asset), a single BufferGeometry updated in place (no per-frame allocation), and dispose geometry+sprite on unmount. Gating is via the scene's isHigh (quality==='high') so the WS2 Fast path only ever runs the tiny variant.

DEP NOTE: used `maath/easing` (damp/damp3) and drei `useCursor` — both already installed (maath 0.10.8 is a drei transitive dep; useCursor ships in @react-three/drei ^10.7). NO new dependency added, per the ASK-before-adding constraint.

VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` clean except the pre-existing @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx (0 errors). `npm run build` (Next 16 static export) succeeded: TypeScript passed (confirms the new optional field + scene props typecheck) and all routes prerendered (/, /projects/chef-chatbot, /projects/coach-trainer, /projects/digital-wardrobe, /projects/virtual-pet, plus _not-found). Machine: sandbox host, Node v22.23.2. No runtime browser frame-time/screenshot capture done here (that is FEAT-004 AFTER-evidence). out/ and .next/ NOT committed.
